reasoning_content: Now, let's wait for the app to start up (since the build is already cached, it should be fast this time), and then start the CMS. I'll do this with a shorter loop to avoid sandbox timeout issues.

action.command:
for i in $(seq 1 5); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:38489/ 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "app UP at check $i"; break; }
  sleep 50
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "app: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:38489/ 2>/dev/null; free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print "available="$6"MB"}'

tool_call.name: terminal
